import numpy as np
def pack(values):
    arrays=[np.asarray(v,dtype=complex) for v in values]
    shape=np.array([x for a in arrays for x in (a.ndim,)+a.shape],dtype=complex)
    return np.concatenate([shape]+[a.ravel() for a in arrays])
h=np.array([[[.2,.3j],[-.3j,-.1]],[[0.,.4],[.4,0.]]]);c=np.array([[[0.,1.],[0.,0.]]]);g=np.array([.17])
assert np.allclose(pack(lindblad_generators(h.copy(),c.copy(),g.copy())), target)
